SELECT e.id AS eid, e.name AS empName, d.name AS depName, s.id AS sid, s.name AS sobName, s.basicSalary, s.bonus, s.lunchSalary, s.trafficSalary, (s.basicSalary + s.bonus + s.lunchSalary + s.trafficSalary) AS shouldPay, ROUND(s.pensionBase * s.pensionPer, 2) AS pension, ROUND(s.medicalBase * s.medicalPer, 2) AS medical, ROUND(s.accumulationFundBase * s.accumulationFundPer, 2) AS fund, ROUND(s.basicSalary + s.bonus + s.lunchSalary + s.trafficSalary - s.pensionBase * s.pensionPer - s.medicalBase * s.medicalPer - s.accumulationFundBase * s.accumulationFundPer, 2) AS actualPay FROM empsalary es LEFT JOIN employee e ON es.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN department d ON e.departmentId = d.id LEFT JOIN salary s ON es.sid = s.id
WHERE e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY e.name
